column1: # Every row is a case where this library and ICU disagree and the
# disagreement is expected. A new one fails the build; a row that stops
# reproducing fails too. An ICU version bump regenerates this file, and
# the diff is the point rather than a nuisance.

column7: CLDR supplemental timeData gives each region a preferred hour cycle, and ICU applies it to the standard time patterns. This library applies it where UTS #35 defines it, which is skeleton resolution through j, and renders the pattern the locale's own chain declares. The skeleton comparison agrees with ICU across all 905 locales. See docs/boundaries.md, the hour cycle a standard time pattern uses.

Hawaiian writes its short date as d/M/yy with numbers="M=romanlow", a per-field numbering system override that selects lowercase Roman numerals for the month alone. This library does not implement the numbers attribute, so the month renders in the locale's default digits. See ROADMAP.md, per-field numbering system overrides.

This locale writes its own time pattern with draft="unconfirmed", which the generator skips: Xml.kt treats unconfirmed and provisional as work in progress and reads the confirmed pattern it inherits instead. ICU uses the draft value. Following CLDR's own readiness ranking is the deliberate choice here.
